rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH remains the confirmed relative-strength leader of the majors and its idiosyncratic flow story STRENGTHENED overnight. CoinDesk: 'Ether outruns bitcoin as ETF money returns, almost all of it from BlackRock's fund' — ETH is up ~11% over 7 days while most other large caps were flat or negative, and U.S. spot ether ETFs pulled ~$96M in the first three sessions of the week (vs the ~$58M one-day figure that anchored yesterday), heavily concentrated in BlackRock's low-fee ETHA while Grayscale's high-fee trust keeps bleeding — the cleanest institutional-bid story in the complex. NEW ETH-specific demand driver: Robinhood Chain, the layer-2 launched Jul 1 that burns ETH for gas, is now processing >$800M/day (mostly memecoin flow), a structural sink for ETH that no other major shares. Macro tailwind intact: softer June CPI keeps the tape risk-on and the House Financial Services 'Clarity Act' hearing lands Jul 17 (tomorrow) — a potential next-24h catalyst for the whole complex that ETH, as the flow leader, is best positioned to capture. On a day where BTC (-0.8% overnight to ~$64,158) and SOL (-1.6% to ~$76.14) both softened while ETH held flat (~$1,883), the all-in stays with the major that owns the improving flow AND held its bid.
positions.driver: ETH carries both relative strength and an improving, idiosyncratic flow story: it led the complex up ~11% on the week, is outrunning BTC on returning ETF money (concentrated in BlackRock ETHA), and now has a structural on-chain demand sink via Robinhood Chain. It held flat overnight while BTC and SOL gave back ground — the correct behavior for the coin you want to be all-in on. Structure is clean: ETH is holding above the $1,800 breakout shelf that flipped from resistance to support, so the stop sits just below at $1,732 (-8%) and the trade invalidates cleanly if $1,800 fails. Runners-up rejected: BTC (~$64,158) — its ETF outflow streak did reverse (~$191M over two days), removing yesterday's 'bleeding' knock, but ETH is still OUTRUNNING it and owns the more concentrated/accelerating flow, so BTC is the lower-beta laggard here; SOL (~$76.14) failed us on Jul 13 (led the bleed not the bounce), softened again overnight, and its Clarity/CLARITY-Act catalyst keeps slipping — extra beta uncompensated; XRP (~$1.106), LINK (~$8.43), DOGE (~$0.073), AVAX (~$6.57) have no fresh idiosyncratic catalyst. Entry = dashboard canonical live feed, asOf 2026-07-16T11:53:22Z (ETH-USD $1,882.78).
positions.risks: ETH is extended after a +11% week and the entry (~$1,883) sits in the upper half of its prior range, so a mean-reversion fade back to retest the $1,800 shelf (then the $1,732 stop) is the obvious risk. Some of the week's move was short-squeeze driven and squeeze rallies give back once forced buying is done. ETF inflows are real but still modest ($96M/3 days) and BTC's ETF bid has also returned — if BTC leads and ETH's relative outperformance stalls, the 'own the flow leader' edge narrows. The Clarity Act hearing (Jul 17) is a binary: a hawkish/disappointing tone or a stalled bill before summer recess could sour the whole complex. Macro remains the master variable — any hot data surprise, hawkish Fed re-pricing, or renewed geopolitics flips the risk-on tape doing most of the work. Robinhood Chain demand is real but memecoin-driven and could fade. Hard stop $1732.16 (-8%), just under the breakout so the trade invalidates cleanly if $1,800 fails as support.
